successors.name: French Africa
successors.text: Tadjoura, seat of the Dardar, whose actual authority 'did not stretch beyond Lake Assal'

ledger.x: 1810: the Adoimara defeat the Asa-yamara and Tadjoura rises as the port of the Dardar, seat of an Afar sultan; the page's sultan list runs from 1620 but gives no extent before the 19th century.
1889: end of the sultanate as an independent port state, after French treaties of 1883-1887; the slave trade abolished by decree 26 Oct 1889.
1889: ends under the French protectorate; the end year is the map's gap, not a page date.

certainty.note: No frontier on the page; the Dardar claimed all northern Adoimara Afar to the Shewa border, actual authority to Lake Assal.
